brief: Checks an org chart for one segregation-of-duties rule: operations must not report directly to treasury.
detail: It takes a snapshot of the chart when it is built. stzOrgChart.ValidateSegregationOfDuties builds one for you.
receiver: oc = new stzOrgChart("TechCo"); oc.AddExecutiveXT("ceo", "CEO"); oc.AddManagerXT("vp", "VP Sales"); oc.ReportsTo("vp", "ceo"); oc.AddPersonXT("p1", "Alice"); oc.AssignPerson("p1", "ceo"); o1 = new stzOrgChartSODValidator(oc)
